1: ## 0. Pemilik tugas
2: 
3: - **Pemilik (rekomendasi):** Muhammad Raihan Fahrifi — Prompt Engineer & LLM Navigator.
4: 
5: ## 1. Tujuan
6: 
7: Implementasi inti Transformer secara manual sesuai kontrak: Sinusoidal Positional Encoding, Causal Multi-Head Self-Attention, Decoder Block (Pre-LayerNorm), dan Feed-Forward Network GELU. Tanpa `nn.Transformer`, `nn.TransformerDecoder`, atau `nn.MultiheadAttention` sebagai pengganti komponen inti.
8: 
9: ## 2. Konteks teknis dan file terkait
10: 
11: - `docs/TECH_SPEC.md` §2 (batas library), §6 (kontrak model), §7 (kompleksitas); `docs/ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md` ADR-002, ADR-004, ADR-007.
12: - File target: `src/model/positional_encoding.py`, `src/model/attention.py`, `src/model/decoder_block.py` (susunan final dikonfirmasi koordinator 2026-10-19 — Opsi 1, tetap per kontrak TECH_SPEC §6).
13: - Konfigurasi baseline: `n_layers=2`, `n_heads=4`, `d_model=64`, `context_length=64`, `d_ff=256`, dropout `0.1`, LayerNorm epsilon `1e-5`.
14: 
15: ## 3. Ruang lingkup
16: 
17: 1. `SinCosPositionalEncoding(d_model, max_len)` — buffer `pe [max_len, d_model]` non-trainable; `forward` menambahkan `pe[:T]`; `T > max_len` → `ValueError`.
18: 2. `CausalMultiHeadAttention(d_model, n_heads, dropout=0.1)` — proyeksi `W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o` (`Linear(d_model, d_model)`); reshape `[B, H, T, head_dim]`; skala `1/sqrt(head_dim)`; causal mask aditif `-inf` di segitiga atas sebelum softmax; gabung head; dropout pada skor dan output attention; validasi `d_model % n_heads == 0` (head_dim 16 untuk baseline).
19: 3. `DecoderBlock(d_model, n_heads, d_ff, dropout=0.1, layer_norm_eps=1e-5, pre_norm=True)` — pre-norm: `x + CausalMHA(LayerNorm(x))`, lalu `x + FFN(LayerNorm(x))`; FFN: `Linear(d_model, d_ff)` → GELU → `Linear(d_ff, d_model)` → dropout; `d_ff = 4 * d_model = 256`.
20: 4. Validasi input, penanganan edge cases, dokumentasi kompleksitas.
21: 5. Unit test setiap komponen (bagian 8).
22: 
23: ## 4. Di luar scope
24: 
25: - MiniGPT, training loop, checkpoint, dan generation (Issue C).
26: - Dataset/tokenizer (Issue A), integrasi tes (Issue D), validasi logging (Issue E).
27: - Sampling generation (opsional v2, bukan baseline).
28: - Tie bobot LM head ke embedding (bukan baseline).
29: 
30: ## 5. Dependensi
31: 
32: - Kontrak sudah dikunci final di `docs/TECH_SPEC.md` (Issue #1) — tidak menunggu Issue lain.
33: - Paralel penuh dengan Issue A.
34: - Issue C membutuhkan modul ini lulus tes untuk integrasi final; Issue D membutuhkannya untuk integrasi tes.
35: 
36: ## 6. Interface dan kontrak (dari TECH_SPEC)
37: 
38: - `SinCosPositionalEncoding(d_model: int, max_len: int)`; `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]`; `T > max_len` → `ValueError`; `max_len = context_length = 64`.
39: - `CausalMultiHeadAttention(d_model: int, n_heads: int, dropout: float = 0.1)`; `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]`; pelanggaran `d_model % n_heads != 0` → `ValueError`.
40: - `DecoderBlock(d_model: int, n_heads: int, d_ff: int, dropout: float = 0.1, layer_norm_eps: float = 1e-5, pre_norm: bool = True)`; `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]`.
41: - Layout komposisi MiniGPT (diimplementasikan Issue C): `Embedding` → `+ PE` → `n_layers` × `DecoderBlock` → LayerNorm akhir → `Linear(d_model, vocab_size)`.
42: - Kompleksitas: attention waktu `O(B·T²·d)`, matriks attention memori `O(B·H·T²)`, FFN waktu `O(B·T·d²)`.
43: 
44: ## 7. Task checklist berurutan
45: 
46: Kerjakan **satu subtask pada satu waktu**, dari atas ke bawah. Jangan menggabungkan beberapa komponen sekaligus; setiap komponen diuji dulu sebelum menjadi fondasi komponen berikutnya.
47: 
48: - [ ] **B1. Periksa kontrak tensor dan parameter pada `TECH_SPEC.md`.** Baca §2, §6, §7 dan ADR-002/004/007; catat seluruh nama kelas, parameter, tensor shapes, dan edge case. *Hasil:* ringkasan kontrak tertulis di laporan AI.
49: - [ ] **B2. Siapkan struktur file dan unit test komponen model.** Buat file target model + kerangka test (shape helper) sesuai kontrak. *Hasil:* struktur file + stub test siap.
50: - [ ] **B3. Implementasikan Sinusoidal Positional Encoding.** Buffer `pe [max_len, d_model]` non-trainable; `forward` menambah `pe[:T]`; `T > max_len` → `ValueError`. *Hasil:* `src/model/positional_encoding.py`.
51: - [ ] **B4. Uji bentuk tensor dan batas `max_len` PE.** Verifikasi shape output `[B, T, d_model]`, buffer non-trainable (`requires_grad=False`), pola sin/cos, `ValueError` saat `T > max_len`. *Hasil:* test PE lulus dengan output aktual.
52: - [ ] **B5. Implementasikan proyeksi Query, Key, dan Value.** `Linear(d_model, d_model)` untuk `W_q, W_k, W_v` (dan `W_o`), jalur `x -> Q/K/V`. *Hasil:* sub-komponen proyeksi teruji shape-nya.
53: - [ ] **B6. Implementasikan scaled dot-product attention.** Skor `QK^T / sqrt(head_dim)`, softmax, `@ V`; dropout pada skor (masking) sebelum softmax. *Hasil:* attention tunggal head berjalan, shape `[B, H, T, head_dim]`.
54: - [ ] **B7. Implementasikan causal mask dan uji dengan perubahan token masa depan.** Mask aditif `-inf` di segitiga atas sebelum softmax; buktikan invariance (ubah logit posisi masa depan tidak mengubah output posisi sebelumnya). *Hasil:* test causal mask lulus.
55: - [ ] **B8. Implementasikan pembagian head, penggabungan head, dan output projection.** Reshape `[B, T, d_model]` → `[B, H, T, head_dim]`, proses attention per head, gabung `[B, T, d_model]`, `W_o`. *Hasil:* multi-head terangkai.
56: - [ ] **B9. Uji Multi-Head Self-Attention.** `CausalMultiHeadAttention` utuh: shape output, perilaku dropout train vs eval, `ValueError` saat `d_model % n_heads != 0`. *Hasil:* test MHA lulus.
57: - [ ] **B10. Implementasikan FFN dengan GELU.** `Linear(d, d_ff)` → GELU → `Linear(d_ff, d)` → dropout; `d_ff = 4 * d_model = 256`. *Hasil:* FFN siap dipasang di DecoderBlock.
58: - [ ] **B11. Implementasikan Decoder Block dengan Pre-LayerNorm, residual connection, dan dropout.** Pre-norm: `x + CausalMHA(LayerNorm(x))`, `x + FFN(LayerNorm(x))`; epsilon `1e-5`. *Hasil:* `src/model/decoder_block.py`.
59: - [ ] **B12. Uji forward pass, backward pass, dan gradient.** Pastikan shape output `[B, T, d]`, forward+backward berjalan, gradien MHA/FFN/LayerNorm/reparam bukan `None`. *Hasil:* tes gradient lulus.
60: - [ ] **B13. Lakukan pengujian integrasi seluruh komponen.** PE → attention → DecoderBlock dijalankan sebagai satu alur bertingkat; verifikasi shape konsisten di tiap lapisan. *Hasil:* integrasi komponen inti lulus.
61: - [ ] **B14. Dokumentasikan kompleksitas dan trade-off algoritma.** Tuliskan kompleksitas waktu/memori (§7), edge cases, dan hasil tes di laporan eksperimen. *Hasil:* laporan lengkap tanpa klaim yang dikarang.
62: 
63: ## 8. Instruksi pengerjaan setiap subtask
64: 
65: 1. Baca kembali bagian spesifikasi yang relevan (`TECH_SPEC.md` §6–§7, ADR-002/004/007).
66: 2. Minta AI menjelaskan tujuan subtask, rumus/enterpretasi tensor shapes `[B, T, d]`, kompleksitas `O(B·T²·d)` / `O(B·H·T²)`, dan edge cases SEBELUM menulis kode.
67: 3. Implementasikan satu subtask saja (perubahan minimal, manual tanpa `nn.MultiheadAttention`/`nn.Transformer*`).
68: 4. Jalankan test subtask itu dan amati output aktual.
69: 5. Jika error, pahami dan perbaiki; catat bukti reproduksi error.
70: 6. Simpan log AI (raw JSONL + laporan Markdown) sesuai ADR-006.
71: 7. Minta review kepada koordinator/anggota lain sebelum menyatakan subtask selesai.
72: 8. Centang checkbox subtask hanya setelah hasil dan test benar-benar terverifikasi.
73: 
74: ## 9. Aturan berhenti
75: 
76: - Setelah satu subtask selesai dan diverifikasi, **berhenti**. Jangan mengerjakan subtask berikutnya tanpa instruksi eksplisit.
77: - Jangan membangun komponen selanjutnya sebelum komponen yang menjadi prasyaratnya lulus test.
78: - Jika hasil test gagal atau log AI belum tersimpan, **jangan lanjut**; perbaiki dulu.
79: - Jangan mengklaim test lulus jika belum dijalankan; jangan mengarang shape, gradien, atau hasil tes.
80: 
81: ## 10. Acceptance criteria (wajib benar-benar diuji)
82: 
83: - [ ] Tidak ada `nn.Transformer`, `nn.TransformerDecoder`, atau `nn.MultiheadAttention` pada jalur inti.
84: - [ ] Tensor shapes output sesuai §6 untuk input acak (test shape dijalankan dan diamati).
85: - [ ] Causal mask terbukti mencegah posisi sebelumnya melihat token masa depan (test invariance: mengubah logit posisi masa depan tidak mengubah output posisi sebelumnya).
86: - [ ] Forward pass dan backward pass berjalan; gradient pada seluruh parameter bukan `None` setelah `loss.backward()`.
87: - [ ] `T > max_len` (PE) dan `d_model % n_heads != 0` (MHA) → `ValueError`.
88: - [ ] Kompleksitas algoritma didokumentasikan sesuai §7.
89: - [ ] Setiap subtask B1–B14 memiliki bukti berupa output aktual atau test yang dijalankan.
90: 
91: ## 11. Unit test yang diperlukan
92: 
93: - PE: buffer non-trainable, pola sin/cos, `ValueError` saat `T > max_len`, shape output.
94: - MHA: shape output, invarian causal mask, validasi head dimension, dropout berperilaku berbeda train vs eval.
95: - DecoderBlock: shape output, jalur residual + pre-norm, dropout train vs eval, gradient mengalir di seluruh sub-komponen.
96: 
97: ## 12. Aturan logging AI
98: 
99: - Ikuti `docs/AI_RULES.md` §6, `docs/AI_LOG_TEMPLATE.md`, dan ADR-006.
100: - Smoke test logging personal (Issue E) WAJIB lolos sebelum coding dimulai.
101: - Raw log di `docs/ai-logs/raw/<member-id>/`, laporan di `docs/ai-logs/reports/`; dilarang menulis API key, token, password, atau data sensitif.
102: 
103: ## 13. Dokumentasi yang harus diperbarui
104: 
105: - Laporan AI di `docs/ai-logs/reports/` sesuai template.
106: - Catatan kompleksitas, edge cases, dan hasil tes di laporan eksperimen (mengikuti template, bukan mengubah `docs/TECH_SPEC.md`/`docs/ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md` tanpa proses ADR).

(End of file - total 106 lines)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn


class DecoderBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-LayerNorm decoder block per TECH_SPEC 6 / ADR-007.

    - Kontrak:
    - `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]`;
    - pre-norm (baseline): `x = x + CausalMHA(LayerNorm(x))`,
      `x = x + FFN(LayerNorm(x))`;
    - FFN: `Linear(d_model, d_ff)` -> GELU -> `Linear(d_ff, d_model)`
      -> dropout; baseline `d_ff = 4 * d_model = 256`;
    - LayerNorm epsilon `1e-5`.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        d_model: int,
        n_heads: int,
        d_ff: int,
        dropout: float = 0.1,
        layer_norm_eps: float = 1e-5,
        pre_norm: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        raise NotImplementedError("implemented in subtasks B10-B11")

1: import math
2: 
3: import torch
4: import torch.nn as nn
5: 
6: 
7: class CausalMultiHeadAttention(nn.Module):
8:     """Causal multi-head self-attention manual per TECH_SPEC 6 / ADR-002.
9: 
10:     - Kontrak:
11:     - `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]`;
12:     - `d_model % n_heads == 0` (head_dim = d_model // n_heads), pelanggaran
13:       -> `ValueError`;
14:     - proyeksi `W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o = Linear(d_model, d_model)`;
15:     - reshape `[B, T, d] -> [B, H, T, d/H]`, skala `1/sqrt(head_dim)`;
16:     - causal mask aditif `-inf` segitiga atas sebelum softmax;
17:     - dropout pada skor sebelum softmax dan pada output attention.
18:     """
19: 
20:     def __init__(self, d_model: int, n_heads: int, dropout: float = 0.1) -> None:
21:         super().__init__()
22:         if n_heads <= 0 or d_model % n_heads != 0:
23:             raise ValueError(
24:                 f"d_model ({d_model}) must be divisible by n_heads ({n_heads})"
25:             )
26:         self.d_model = d_model
27:         self.n_heads = n_heads
28:         self.head_dim = d_model // n_heads
29:         self.dropout = dropout
30:         self.attn_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
31:         self.out_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
32:         self.w_q = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)
33:         self.w_k = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)
34:         self.w_v = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)
35:         self.w_o = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)
36: 
37:     def _project_qkv(
38:         self, x: torch.Tensor
39:     ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
40:         """x: [B, T, d_model] -> q, k, v: [B, T, d_model]."""
41:         return self.w_q(x), self.w_k(x), self.w_v(x)
42: 
43:     def _causal_mask(
44:         self,
45:         t: int,
46:         device: torch.device | None = None,
47:         dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
48:     ) -> torch.Tensor:
49:         """Additive causal mask: `-inf` strictly above the diagonal.
50: 
51:         Returns `[1, 1, T, T]`, broadcast-compatible with scores
52:         `[B, H, T, T]`. Position `i` may attend to `j <= i` only;
53:         `T = 1` yields a single zero (no future positions).
54:         """
55:         idx = torch.arange(t, device=device)
56:         mask = torch.where(idx[None, :] > idx[:, None], float("-inf"), 0.0)
57:         if dtype is not None:
58:             mask = mask.to(dtype)
59:         return mask.view(1, 1, t, t)
60: 
61:     def _scaled_dot_product_attention(
62:         self,
63:         q: torch.Tensor,
64:         k: torch.Tensor,
65:         v: torch.Tensor,
66:         mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
67:     ) -> torch.Tensor:
68:         """Scaled dot-product attention per head (subtask B6).
69: 
70:         - q, k, v: [B, H, T, head_dim] -> out: [B, H, T, head_dim];
71:         - skor QK^T / sqrt(head_dim), dropout skor pre-softmax,
72:           softmax, lalu @ V;
73:         - `mask` tambahan aditif [B, H, T, T]-compatible dijumlahkan
74:           ke skor sebelum softmax (dipakai causal mask di B7).
75:         """
76:         for name, tensor in (("q", q), ("k", k), ("v", v)):
77:             if tensor.dim() != 4:
78:                 raise ValueError(
79:                     f"{name}: expected 4D [B, H, T, head_dim], got {tensor.dim()}D"
80:                 )
81:             if tensor.size(-1) != self.head_dim:
82:                 raise ValueError(
83:                     f"{name}: expected last dim {self.head_dim}, "
84:                     f"got {tensor.size(-1)}"
85:                 )
86:         scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)
87:         scores = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1) * scale  # [B, H, T, T]
88:         if mask is not None:
89:             scores = scores + mask
90:         scores = self.attn_dropout(scores)
91:         probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)  # [B, H, T, T]
92:         return probs @ v  # [B, H, T, head_dim]
93: 
94:     def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
95:         """x: [B, T, d_model] -> [B, T, d_model] (subtasks B5-B8).
96: 
97:         Alur: proyeksi Q/K/V -> split [B, H, T, head_dim] ->
98:         scaled dot-product attention dgn causal mask -> gabung head ->
99:         output projection `W_o` -> dropout output attention.
100:         """
101:         if x.dim() != 3:
102:             raise ValueError(
103:                 f"expected 3D input [B, T, d_model], got {x.dim()}D"
104:             )
105:         if x.size(-1) != self.d_model:
106:             raise ValueError(
107:                 f"expected last dim {self.d_model}, got {x.size(-1)}"
108:             )
109:         b, t, d = x.size()
110:         q, k, v = self._project_qkv(x)  # masing-masing [B, T, d_model]
111:         q = q.view(b, t, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
112:         k = k.view(b, t, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
113:         v = v.view(b, t, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
114:         mask = self._causal_mask(t, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
115:         attn_out = self._scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, mask)  # [B, H, T, d/H]
116:         attn_out = attn_out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(b, t, d)
117:         out = self.w_o(attn_out)  # output projection [B, T, d_model]
118:         return self.out_dropout(out)

</content>

1: # Technical Specification
2: 
3: **Status:** Final untuk baseline Issue #1 (Step 2). Keputusan yang tercantum dicatat pada `ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md`. Perubahan arsitektur atau kontrak publik wajib melalui ADR baru dan persetujuan tim.
4: 
5: ## 1. Keputusan arsitektur
6: 
7: | Komponen | Keputusan | ADR |
8: |---|---|---|
9: | Framework | Python + PyTorch | ADR-001 |
10: | Arsitektur | Decoder-only transformer, next-token prediction | ADR-001 |
11: | Attention | Causal Multi-Head Self-Attention manual (tanpa `nn.MultiheadAttention`/`nn.Transformer`) | ADR-002 |
12: | Positional encoding | Sinusoidal, implementasi mandiri | ADR-002 |
13: | Decoder Block | Pre-LayerNorm; residual; FFN `d_ff = 4 * d_model`; GELU; dropout `0.1`; LayerNorm epsilon `1e-5` | ADR-007 |
14: | Tokenizer | Regex `r"\w+|[^\w\s]"`; lowercase sebelum tokenisasi | ADR-008 |
15: | Special tokens | `<pad>=0`, `<bos>=1`, `<eos>=2`, `<unk>=3` | ADR-008 |
16: | Dataset | Indonesian News Datasets (kolom `content`); subset awal 1.000 artikel | ADR-003, ADR-012 |
17: | Split | Per dokumen; split bawaan train/test dipertahankan; validation 10% dari train (seed 42); fallback 80/10/10 tidak dipakai | ADR-010, ADR-012 |
18: | Objektif | Next-token prediction | ADR-001 |
19: | Loss | Cross-Entropy, token pad di target diabaikan (`ignore_index=pad_id`) | TECH_SPEC §5 |
20: | Optimizer | AdamW; awal `lr=3e-4`, `weight_decay=0.01` | TECH_SPEC §6 |
21: | Konfigurasi awal | `n_layers=2`, `n_heads=4`, `d_model=64`, `context_length=64`, `d_ff=256` | ADR-004 |
22: | Seed | 42 (split data dan random seed) | ADR-010 |
23: 
24: Semua angka hiperparameter adalah titik awal yang boleh disesuaikan melalui eksperimen terdokumentasi, tanpa mengubah arsitektur inti.
25: 
26: ## 2. Batas library
27: 
28: Dilarang menggunakan `nn.Transformer`, `nn.TransformerDecoder`, atau `nn.MultiheadAttention` untuk menggantikan inti implementasi manual. Operasi tensor dasar, `nn.Linear`, `nn.Embedding`, autograd, loss, optimizer, dan utilitas dasar PyTorch diizinkan. Tidak boleh memakai pretrained model atau external GPT API sebagai model proyek.
29: 
30: ## 3. Kontrak tokenizer
31: 
32: File target: `src/data/tokenizer.py`.
33: 
34: - `fit(texts: Sequence[str]) -> None` — bangun vocabulary **hanya dari data train**. Urutan id: `<pad>=0`, `<bos>=1`, `<eos>=2`, `<unk>=3`, lalu token hasil regex diurutkan berdasarkan frekuensi (tidak ada batas vocab tetap; dicatat saat eksperimen).
35: - `encode(text: str) -> list[int]` — normalisasi lowercase, tokenisasi `re.findall(r"\w+|[^\w\s]", text)`, karakter/token di luar vocab → `<unk>`.
36: - `decode(ids: Sequence[int]) -> str` — gabung token kata/tanda baca dengan spasi, lalu `strip`; `bos/eos/pad/unk` tidak dirender (atau dirender sebagai spasi kosong). Roundtrip `decode(encode(t)) == t` tidak dijamin; ini perilaku yang didokumentasikan, bukan bug.
37: - Properti `vocab_size: int` tersedia setelah `fit`.
38: 
39: Perilaku token khusus: `<bos>` dan `<eos>` **tidak** dikirim sebagai string literal ke regex; keduanya disisipkan sebagai token id langsung pada tahap dataset (lihat §4).
40: 
41: ## 4. Kontrak dataset
42: 
43: File target: `src/data/dataset.py`.
44: 
45: Urutan pemrosesan dokumen (wajib):
46: 1. Deduplikasi berdasarkan konten ternormalisasi.
47: 2. Split per dokumen: 80/10/10, seed 42 — **hanya jika** split bawaan dataset tidak tersedia atau tidak layak. Jika split bawaan ada dan terverifikasi, pertahankan tanpa resplit.
48: 3. Tokenisasi tiap dokumen (mengikuti tokenizer).
49: 4. Sisipkan `bos_id` di awal dan `eos_id` di akhir urutan token tiap dokumen.
50: 5. Bangun window:
51:    - Dokumen dengan ≥ 65 token: sliding window panjang 65, stride 1.
52:    - Setiap window → `x = ids[:64]`, `y = ids[1:65]`.
53:    - Dokumen pendek: buat satu pasangan pendek (`x = ids[:-1]`, `y = ids[1:]`) saat tersedia; padding ke panjang penuh dilakukan pada tahap batching.
54:    - Dilarang membuat window melintasi batas dokumen.
55: 
56: Output batch (via `DataLoader`, collate pad → `pad_id`):
57: - `x`: `[B, T]` int64, `T = context_length = 64`
58: - `y`: `[B, T]` int64
59: - `x[i, t] == y[i, t-1]` untuk semua posisi non-pad.
60: 
61: Edge cases: dokumen hasil tokenisasi kosong dibuang; dokumen 1 token tidak menghasilkan pasangan input-target; vocab tidak pernah di-fit dari test.
62: 
63: ## 5. Kontrak perhitungan loss
64: 
65: - `CrossEntropyLoss(ignore_index=pad_id)` pada logits `[B, T, V]` vs target `[B, T]` (flat `[B*T, V]` vs `[B*T]`).
66: - Posisi target berisi `pad_id` tidak berkontribusi ke loss.
67: 
68: ## 6. Kontrak model dan training
69: 
70: ### Positional Encoding (`src/model/positional_encoding.py`)
71: 
72: - `SinCosPositionalEncoding(d_model: int, max_len: int)`, buffer `pe: [max_len, d_model]` non-trainable.
73: - `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]` — tambahkan `pe[:T]`.
74: - `T > max_len` → `ValueError`. `max_len = context_length = 64`.
75: 
76: ### Causal Multi-Head Self-Attention (`src/model/attention.py`)
77: 
78: - `CausalMultiHeadAttention(d_model: int, n_heads: int, dropout: float = 0.1)`.
79: - `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]`.
80: - `d_model % n_heads == 0`, `head_dim = d_model // n_heads` (16 untuk baseline); pelanggaran → `ValueError`.
81: - Urutan: proyeksi `W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o` (`Linear(d_model, d_model)`); reshape ke `[B, H, T, head_dim]`; skala `1/sqrt(head_dim)`; causal mask aditif (`-inf`) di segitiga atas sebelum softmax; gabung head; `W_o`; dropout pada skor sebelum softmax dan pada output attention.
82: 
83: ### Decoder Block (`src/model/decoder_block.py`)
84: 
85: - `DecoderBlock(d_model: int, n_heads: int, d_ff: int, dropout: float = 0.1, layer_norm_eps: float = 1e-5, pre_norm: bool = True)`.
86: - `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]`.
87: - Pre-norm (baseline): `x = x + CausalMHA(LayerNorm(x))`; `x = x + FFN(LayerNorm(x))`.
88: - FFN: `Linear(d_model, d_ff)` → GELU → `Linear(d_ff, d_model)` → dropout. `d_ff = 4 * d_model = 256`.
89: 
90: ### MiniGPT (`src/model/minigpt.py`)
91: 
92: - `MiniGPT(vocab_size: int, n_layers: int = 2, n_heads: int = 4, d_model: int = 64, context_length: int = 64, dropout: float = 0.1, layer_norm_eps: float = 1e-5)`.
93: - `forward(idx: [B, T] int64) -> logits: [B, T, vocab_size] float32`.
94: - Komposisi: `Embedding(V, d)` → + PE → `n_layers` × DecoderBlock → LayerNorm akhir → `Linear(d, V)` (bobot LM head tidak di-tie ke embedding pada baseline).
95: - `T > context_length` → `ValueError`.
96: 
97: ### Training (`src/train.py`)
98: 
99: - Batch size 32; epochs 10 (awal); AdamW `lr=3e-4`, `weight_decay=0.01`; seed 42 (Python, NumPy, PyTorch).
100: - Tiap epoch: hitung train loss dan validation loss; catat ke `outputs/metrics/` (format JSONL; ADR-011) dan laporkan di laporan akhir.
101: 
102: ### Generation (`src/generate.py`)
103: 
104: - Versi pertama: **greedy decoding** (argmax tiap langkah; `temperature` sampling opsional, tidak wajib).
105: - `generate(prompt: str, max_new_tokens: int = 64) -> str`.
106: - Alur: lowercase → `encode` → prepend `bos_id` → loop; berhenti saat menghasilkan `eos_id` atau mencapai `max_new_tokens`; konteks dibatasi ke `context_length` terakhir (window geser) jika melebihi.
107: 
108: ## 7. Kompleksitas dan memori
109: 
110: Dengan batch `B`, urutan `T`, dimensi `d`, head `H`:
111: - Attention: waktu `O(B * T^2 * d)`.
112: - Matriks attention: memori `O(B * H * T^2)`.
113: - FFN: waktu `O(B * T * d^2)` bila `d_ff` seorde dengan `d` (baseline `d_ff = 4d` tetap `O(d^2)`).
114: 
115: Contoh baseline (`B=32, T=64, d=64, H=4`): attention time ≈ 32·4096·64 ≈ 8,4M operasi per blok; matriks attention ≈ 32·4·4096 = 524.288 elemen (≈2 MiB fp32). Gunakan parameter aktual dan cantumkan asumsi pada laporan.
116: 
117: ## 8. Data split
118: 
119: - Split bawaan dataset (train 25.8k / test 6.46k) dipertahankan tanpa resplit (ADR-010). Tidak ada split validation bawaan, sehingga validation diambil 10% dari split train (seed 42) — ADR-012. Fallback 80/10/10 tidak digunakan pada proyek ini.
120: - Jangan pegang test split bawaan jika tersedia dan kualitasnya terverifikasi; jika tidak, fallback 80/10/10 seed 42.
121: - Split dilakukan per dokumen sebelum tokenisasi dan pembuatan window (mencegah kebocoran antarartikel).
122: - Strategi aktual (jumlah artikel per split, jumlah token, ukuran vocab) dicatat di `DATASET_CARD.md` pada langkah dataset.

(End of file - total 122 lines)
</content>

# Technical Specification

**Status:** Final untuk baseline Issue #1 (Step 2). Keputusan yang tercantum dicatat pada `ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md`. Perubahan arsitektur atau kontrak publik wajib melalui ADR baru dan persetujuan tim.

## 1. Keputusan arsitektur

| Komponen | Keputusan | ADR |
|---|---|---|
| Framework | Python + PyTorch | ADR-001 |
| Arsitektur | Decoder-only transformer, next-token prediction | ADR-001 |
| Attention | Causal Multi-Head Self-Attention manual (tanpa `nn.MultiheadAttention`/`nn.Transformer`) | ADR-002 |
| Positional encoding | Sinusoidal, implementasi mandiri | ADR-002 |
| Decoder Block | Pre-LayerNorm; residual; FFN `d_ff = 4 * d_model`; GELU; dropout `0.1`; LayerNorm epsilon `1e-5` | ADR-007 |
| Tokenizer | Regex `r"\w+|[^\w\s]"`; lowercase sebelum tokenisasi | ADR-008 |
| Special tokens | `<pad>=0`, `<bos>=1`, `<eos>=2`, `<unk>=3` | ADR-008 |
| Dataset | Indonesian News Datasets (kolom `content`); subset awal 1.000 artikel | ADR-003, ADR-012 |
| Split | Per dokumen; split bawaan train/test dipertahankan; validation 10% dari train (seed 42); fallback 80/10/10 tidak dipakai | ADR-010, ADR-012 |
| Objektif | Next-token prediction | ADR-001 |
| Loss | Cross-Entropy, token pad di target diabaikan (`ignore_index=pad_id`) | TECH_SPEC §5 |
| Optimizer | AdamW; awal `lr=3e-4`, `weight_decay=0.01` | TECH_SPEC §6 |
| Konfigurasi awal | `n_layers=2`, `n_heads=4`, `d_model=64`, `context_length=64`, `d_ff=256` | ADR-004 |
| Seed | 42 (split data dan random seed) | ADR-010 |

Semua angka hiperparameter adalah titik awal yang boleh disesuaikan melalui eksperimen terdokumentasi, tanpa mengubah arsitektur inti.

## 2. Batas library

Dilarang menggunakan `nn.Transformer`, `nn.TransformerDecoder`, atau `nn.MultiheadAttention` untuk menggantikan inti implementasi manual. Operasi tensor dasar, `nn.Linear`, `nn.Embedding`, autograd, loss, optimizer, dan utilitas dasar PyTorch diizinkan. Tidak boleh memakai pretrained model atau external GPT API sebagai model proyek.

## 3. Kontrak tokenizer

File target: `src/data/tokenizer.py`.

- `fit(texts: Sequence[str]) -> None` — bangun vocabulary **hanya dari data train**. Urutan id: `<pad>=0`, `<bos>=1`, `<eos>=2`, `<unk>=3`, lalu token hasil regex diurutkan berdasarkan frekuensi (tidak ada batas vocab tetap; dicatat saat eksperimen).
- `encode(text: str) -> list[int]` — normalisasi lowercase, tokenisasi `re.findall(r"\w+|[^\w\s]", text)`, karakter/token di luar vocab → `<unk>`.
- `decode(ids: Sequence[int]) -> str` — gabung token kata/tanda baca dengan spasi, lalu `strip`; `bos/eos/pad/unk` tidak dirender (atau dirender sebagai spasi kosong). Roundtrip `decode(encode(t)) == t` tidak dijamin; ini perilaku yang didokumentasikan, bukan bug.
- Properti `vocab_size: int` tersedia setelah `fit`.

Perilaku token khusus: `<bos>` dan `<eos>` **tidak** dikirim sebagai string literal ke regex; keduanya disisipkan sebagai token id langsung pada tahap dataset (lihat §4).

## 4. Kontrak dataset

File target: `src/data/dataset.py`.

Urutan pemrosesan dokumen (wajib):
1. Deduplikasi berdasarkan konten ternormalisasi.
2. Split per dokumen: 80/10/10, seed 42 — **hanya jika** split bawaan dataset tidak tersedia atau tidak layak. Jika split bawaan ada dan terverifikasi, pertahankan tanpa resplit.
3. Tokenisasi tiap dokumen (mengikuti tokenizer).
4. Sisipkan `bos_id` di awal dan `eos_id` di akhir urutan token tiap dokumen.
5. Bangun window:
   - Dokumen dengan ≥ 65 token: sliding window panjang 65, stride 1.
   - Setiap window → `x = ids[:64]`, `y = ids[1:65]`.
   - Dokumen pendek: buat satu pasangan pendek (`x = ids[:-1]`, `y = ids[1:]`) saat tersedia; padding ke panjang penuh dilakukan pada tahap batching.
   - Dilarang membuat window melintasi batas dokumen.

Output batch (via `DataLoader`, collate pad → `pad_id`):
- `x`: `[B, T]` int64, `T = context_length = 64`
- `y`: `[B, T]` int64
- `x[i, t] == y[i, t-1]` untuk semua posisi non-pad.

Edge cases: dokumen hasil tokenisasi kosong dibuang; dokumen 1 token tidak menghasilkan pasangan input-target; vocab tidak pernah di-fit dari test.

## 5. Kontrak perhitungan loss

- `CrossEntropyLoss(ignore_index=pad_id)` pada logits `[B, T, V]` vs target `[B, T]` (flat `[B*T, V]` vs `[B*T]`).
- Posisi target berisi `pad_id` tidak berkontribusi ke loss.

## 6. Kontrak model dan training

### Positional Encoding (`src/model/positional_encoding.py`)

- `SinCosPositionalEncoding(d_model: int, max_len: int)`, buffer `pe: [max_len, d_model]` non-trainable.
- `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]` — tambahkan `pe[:T]`.
- `T > max_len` → `ValueError`. `max_len = context_length = 64`.

### Causal Multi-Head Self-Attention (`src/model/attention.py`)

- `CausalMultiHeadAttention(d_model: int, n_heads: int, dropout: float = 0.1)`.
- `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]`.
- `d_model % n_heads == 0`, `head_dim = d_model // n_heads` (16 untuk baseline); pelanggaran → `ValueError`.
- Urutan: proyeksi `W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o` (`Linear(d_model, d_model)`); reshape ke `[B, H, T, head_dim]`; skala `1/sqrt(head_dim)`; causal mask aditif (`-inf`) di segitiga atas sebelum softmax; gabung head; `W_o`; dropout pada skor sebelum softmax dan pada output attention.

### Decoder Block (`src/model/decoder_block.py`)

- `DecoderBlock(d_model: int, n_heads: int, d_ff: int, dropout: float = 0.1, layer_norm_eps: float = 1e-5, pre_norm: bool = True)`.
- `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]`.
- Pre-norm (baseline): `x = x + CausalMHA(LayerNorm(x))`; `x = x + FFN(LayerNorm(x))`.
- FFN: `Linear(d_model, d_ff)` → GELU → `Linear(d_ff, d_model)` → dropout. `d_ff = 4 * d_model = 256`.

### MiniGPT (`src/model/minigpt.py`)

- `MiniGPT(vocab_size: int, n_layers: int = 2, n_heads: int = 4, d_model: int = 64, context_length: int = 64, dropout: float = 0.1, layer_norm_eps: float = 1e-5)`.
- `forward(idx: [B, T] int64) -> logits: [B, T, vocab_size] float32`.
- Komposisi: `Embedding(V, d)` → + PE → `n_layers` × DecoderBlock → LayerNorm akhir → `Linear(d, V)` (bobot LM head tidak di-tie ke embedding pada baseline).
- `T > context_length` → `ValueError`.

### Training (`src/train.py`)

- Batch size 32; epochs 10 (awal); AdamW `lr=3e-4`, `weight_decay=0.01`; seed 42 (Python, NumPy, PyTorch).
- Tiap epoch: hitung train loss dan validation loss; catat ke `outputs/metrics/` (format JSONL; ADR-011) dan laporkan di laporan akhir.

### Generation (`src/generate.py`)

- Versi pertama: **greedy decoding** (argmax tiap langkah; `temperature` sampling opsional, tidak wajib).
- `generate(prompt: str, max_new_tokens: int = 64) -> str`.
- Alur: lowercase → `encode` → prepend `bos_id` → loop; berhenti saat menghasilkan `eos_id` atau mencapai `max_new_tokens`; konteks dibatasi ke `context_length` terakhir (window geser) jika melebihi.

## 7. Kompleksitas dan memori

Dengan batch `B`, urutan `T`, dimensi `d`, head `H`:
- Attention: waktu `O(B * T^2 * d)`.
- Matriks attention: memori `O(B * H * T^2)`.
- FFN: waktu `O(B * T * d^2)` bila `d_ff` seorde dengan `d` (baseline `d_ff = 4d` tetap `O(d^2)`).

Contoh baseline (`B=32, T=64, d=64, H=4`): attention time ≈ 32·4096·64 ≈ 8,4M operasi per blok; matriks attention ≈ 32·4·4096 = 524.288 elemen (≈2 MiB fp32). Gunakan parameter aktual dan cantumkan asumsi pada laporan.

## 8. Data split

- Split bawaan dataset (train 25.8k / test 6.46k) dipertahankan tanpa resplit (ADR-010). Tidak ada split validation bawaan, sehingga validation diambil 10% dari split train (seed 42) — ADR-012. Fallback 80/10/10 tidak digunakan pada proyek ini.
- Jangan pegang test split bawaan jika tersedia dan kualitasnya terverifikasi; jika tidak, fallback 80/10/10 seed 42.
- Split dilakukan per dokumen sebelum tokenisasi dan pembuatan window (mencegah kebocoran antarartikel).
- Strategi aktual (jumlah artikel per split, jumlah token, ukuran vocab) dicatat di `DATASET_CARD.md` pada langkah dataset.

import unittest

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

from src.model.attention import CausalMultiHeadAttention

B, T, D_MODEL = 2, 8, 64
N_HEADS = 4
HEAD_DIM = D_MODEL // N_HEADS
DROPOUT = 0.1


def _assert_shape(tensor: torch.Tensor, expected: tuple) -> None:
    assert tuple(tensor.shape) == expected, (
        f"shape {tuple(tensor.shape)} != expected {expected}"
    )


class TestProjectionQKV(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.attn = CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, N_HEADS)
        self.x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)

    def test_projections_are_linear(self):
        for name in ("w_q", "w_k", "w_v", "w_o"):
            mod = getattr(self.attn, name)
            self.assertIsInstance(mod, nn.Linear)
            self.assertEqual(mod.weight.shape, (D_MODEL, D_MODEL))
            self.assertEqual(mod.bias.shape, (D_MODEL,))

    def test_qkv_output_shape(self):
        q, k, v = self.attn._project_qkv(self.x)
        for tensor in (q, k, v):
            _assert_shape(tensor, (B, T, D_MODEL))

    def test_w_o_is_separate(self):
        self.assertIsNot(self.attn.w_o, self.attn.w_q)
        self.assertIsNot(self.attn.w_o, self.attn.w_k)
        self.assertIsNot(self.attn.w_o, self.attn.w_v)

    def test_gradient_flows_through_projections(self):
        q, k, v = self.attn._project_qkv(self.x)
        loss = q.sum() + k.sum() + v.sum()
        loss.backward()
        for name in ("w_q", "w_k", "w_v"):
            grad = getattr(self.attn, name).weight.grad
            self.assertIsNotNone(grad)
            self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(grad, torch.zeros_like(grad)))

    def test_value_error_when_heads_dont_divide(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, n_heads=5)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, n_heads=0)


class TestScaledDotProductAttention(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.attn = CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, N_HEADS, dropout=0.0)
        self.attn.eval()
        self.q = torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, T, HEAD_DIM)
        self.k = torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, T, HEAD_DIM)
        self.v = torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, T, HEAD_DIM)

    def test_output_shape(self):
        out = self.attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(self.q, self.k, self.v)
        _assert_shape(out, (B, N_HEADS, T, HEAD_DIM))

    def test_matches_manual_scaled_attention(self):
        scores = self.q @ self.k.transpose(-2, -1) * (HEAD_DIM ** -0.5)
        probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
        expected = probs @ self.v
        out = self.attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(self.q, self.k, self.v)
        torch.testing.assert_close(out, expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

    def test_scale_is_applied(self):
        q = torch.cat([torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, 1, HEAD_DIM)] * 2, dim=2)
        k = torch.cat(
            [
                torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, 1, HEAD_DIM) * 10.0,
                torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, 1, HEAD_DIM),
            ],
            dim=2,
        )
        v = torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, 2, HEAD_DIM)
        scaled = self.attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        scores_scaled = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1) * (HEAD_DIM ** -0.5)
        expected_scaled = torch.softmax(scores_scaled, dim=-1) @ v
        scores_unscaled = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)
        expected_unscaled = torch.softmax(scores_unscaled, dim=-1) @ v
        torch.testing.assert_close(scaled, expected_scaled, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)
        self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(scaled, expected_unscaled, atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-4))

    def test_value_error_on_wrong_shape(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(
                torch.randn(B, T, HEAD_DIM), self.k, self.v
            )
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(
                torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, T, HEAD_DIM + 1), self.k, self.v
            )

    def test_gradient_flows(self):
        q = self.q.clone().requires_grad_(True)
        k = self.k.clone().requires_grad_(True)
        v = self.v.clone().requires_grad_(True)
        out = self.attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        out.sum().backward()
        for tensor in (q, k, v):
            grad = tensor.grad
            self.assertIsNotNone(grad)
            self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(grad, torch.zeros_like(grad)))

    def test_dropout_train_differs_from_eval(self):
        attn = CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, N_HEADS, dropout=DROPOUT)
        q, k, v = self.q, self.k, self.v
        attn.train()
        out_train_a = attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        out_train_b = attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        attn.eval()
        out_eval_a = attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        out_eval_b = attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(out_train_a, out_train_b))
        torch.testing.assert_close(out_eval_a, out_eval_b, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)


class TestAttentionShape(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_output_shape(self):
        attn = CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, N_HEADS)
        _assert_shape(attn(torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)), (B, T, D_MODEL))

    def test_output_shape_varied_batch_and_length(self):
        attn = CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, N_HEADS)
        attn.eval()
        for batch, length in ((1, 1), (4, 16), (B, T)):
            x = torch.randn(batch, length, D_MODEL)
            _assert_shape(attn(x), (batch, length, D_MODEL))

    def test_output_is_float32(self):
        attn = CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, N_HEADS)
        out = attn(torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL))
        self.assertEqual(out.dtype, torch.float32)

    def test_gradient_flows_end_to_end(self):
        attn = CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, N_HEADS, dropout=0.0)
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL, requires_grad=True)
        out = attn(x)
        out.sum().backward()
        for name in ("w_q", "w_k", "w_v", "w_o"):
            grad = getattr(attn, name).weight.grad
            self.assertIsNotNone(grad)
            self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(grad, torch.zeros_like(grad)))


class TestAttentionValidation(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_value_error_when_heads_do_not_divide(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, n_heads=5)

    def test_value_error_when_zero_heads(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, n_heads=0)

    def test_value_error_when_more_heads_than_d_model(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, n_heads=D_MODEL + 1)


class TestCausalMask(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.attn = CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, N_HEADS, dropout=0.0)

    def test_mask_shape(self):
        mask = self.attn._causal_mask(T)
        _assert_shape(mask, (1, 1, T, T))

    def test_mask_is_upper_triangular_negative_infinity(self):
        mask = self.attn._causal_mask(T)[0, 0]
        for i in range(T):
            for j in range(T):
                if j > i:
                    self.assertEqual(mask[i, j], float("-inf"))
                else:
                    self.assertEqual(mask[i, j], 0.0)

    def test_mask_t1_has_no_future(self):
        mask = self.attn._causal_mask(1)
        _assert_shape(mask, (1, 1, 1, 1))
        self.assertEqual(mask[0, 0, 0, 0], 0.0)

    def test_mask_respects_dtype_and_device(self):
        mask = self.attn._causal_mask(T, dtype=torch.float64)
        self.assertEqual(mask.dtype, torch.float64)

    def test_causal_invariance_with_future_token_changes(self):
        q = torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, T, HEAD_DIM)
        k = torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, T, HEAD_DIM)
        v = torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, T, HEAD_DIM)
        mask = self.attn._causal_mask(T)
        out_a = self.attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, mask)

        q_future = q.clone()
        k_future = k.clone()
        v_future = v.clone()
        q_future[:, :, T // 2 :, :] = torch.randn_like(q_future[:, :, T // 2 :, :])
        k_future[:, :, T // 2 :, :] = torch.randn_like(k_future[:, :, T // 2 :, :])
        v_future[:, :, T // 2 :, :] = torch.randn_like(v_future[:, :, T // 2 :, :])
        out_b = self.attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(
            q_future, k_future, v_future, mask
        )

        torch.testing.assert_close(
            out_a[:, :, : T // 2, :], out_b[:, :, : T // 2, :], atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6
        )
        self.assertFalse(
            torch.allclose(out_a[:, :, T // 2 :, :], out_b[:, :, T // 2 :, :])
        )

    def test_invariance_fails_without_mask(self):
        q = torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, T, HEAD_DIM)
        k = torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, T, HEAD_DIM)
        v = torch.randn(B, N_HEADS, T, HEAD_DIM)
        out_a = self.attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)

        v_future = v.clone()
        v_future[:, :, T // 2 :, :] = torch.randn_like(v_future[:, :, T // 2 :, :])
        out_b = self.attn._scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v_future)

        self.assertFalse(
            torch.allclose(out_a[:, :, : T // 2, :], out_b[:, :, : T // 2, :])
        )


class TestDropoutBehavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_train_differs_from_eval(self):
        attn = CausalMultiHeadAttention(D_MODEL, N_HEADS, dropout=DROPOUT)
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        attn.train()
        out_train_a = attn(x)
        out_train_b = attn(x)
        attn.eval()
        out_eval_a = attn(x)
        out_eval_b = attn(x)
        self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(out_train_a, out_train_b))
        torch.testing.assert_close(out_eval_a, out_eval_b, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

7: ## ADR-001 — Mini-GPT berbasis Decoder-only Transformer
8: - Konteks: Tugas meminta model bahasa kecil dari-nol; tim 4 anggota, durasi 2 minggu.

15: - Konteks: Rubrik mengharuskan implementasi dari-nol; `nn.Transformer*`/`nn.MultiheadAttention` dilarang menggantikan inti.
16: - Keputusan: Menerapkan causal Multi-Head Self-Attention dan sinusoidal positional encoding sendiri dengan operasi dasar PyTorch.
17: - Alasan: Memenuhi tujuan pembelajaran dan batas library `AGENTS.md`/`TECH_SPEC.md` §2.
18: - Trade-off: Lebih banyak kode dan pengujian dibanding modul Transformer lengkap.
19: - Status: Accepted.

21: ## ADR-003 — Dataset berita bahasa Indonesia
22: - Konteks: Perlu korpus teks untuk language modeling tanpa scrap dari nol.
23: - Keputusan: Memakai subset Indonesian News Datasets (kolom `content`), 500–2.000 artikel untuk pipeline awal.
24: - Alasan: Mempercepat penyiapan korpus dan menyediakan teks berbahasa Indonesia.
25: - Trade-off: Label belum dikurasi; provenance dan lisensi (CC BY-NC 4.0) serta hak sumber wajib ditinjau; hasil generasi hanya demonstrasi pendidikan.
26: - Status: Accepted.
27: 
28: ## ADR-004 — Konfigurasi awal kecil
29: - Konteks: Model pertama harus bisa di-debug dan dilatih CPU; dimensi harus konsisten antar modul.
30: - Keputusan: Mulai dari `n_layers=2`, `n_heads=4`, `d_model=64`, `context_length=64`, `d_ff=256`. `d_model % n_heads == 0` (head_dim 16).
31: - Alasan: Dimensi kecil memudahkan debugging; `B·H·T² = 32·4·4096` ≈ 2 MiB per matriks attention.
32: - Trade-off: Kapasitas model dan kualitas generasi terbatas.
33: - Status: Accepted (baseline disahkan via Issue #1 Step 2). Catatan: verifikasi bentuk tensor aktual dilakukan pada langkah implementasi; jika shape test menemukan ketidakcocokan, revisi ADR wajib dicatat.
34: 
35: ## ADR-005 — Contract-first parallel development
36: - Konteks: Empat anggota memakai AI coding agent berbeda; risiko drift interface antar modul tinggi.
37: - Keputusan: Definisikan interface, nama fungsi/kelas, parameter, dan tensor shapes sebelum modul dikerjakan paralel.
38: - Alasan: Mengurangi konflik integrasi dan perbedaan output antar agent.
39: - Trade-off: Perlu disiplin menjaga kontrak tetap konsisten selama implementasi.
40: - Status: Accepted.
41: 
42: ## ADR-006 — Pencatatan log AI
43: - Konteks: `AI_RULES.md` §6 mewajibkan prompt, respons, event tool, dan error terekam; bentuk event tiap agent berbeda.
44: - Keputusan: Adapter logging per tool; format raw distandarkan ke JSONL di `docs/ai-logs/raw/<member-id>/` dan laporan Markdown mengikuti `docs/AI_LOG_TEMPLATE.md`; konten rahasia di-redact.
45: - Alasan: Tool berbeda mengekspos event/transcript secara berbeda; raw log wajib jadi bukti.
46: - Trade-off: Setiap adapter perlu diuji; laporan otomatis masih meninggalkan field manual `[Isi manual]` yang wajib dilengkapi anggota.
47: - Status keputusan: Accepted.
48: - Tingkat implementasi/verifikasi (terpisah dari keputusan): plugin `.kilo/plugin/mini-transformer-logger.ts` aktif dan teruji pada Kilo untuk anggota `raihanfahrifi-80017` (dua sesi, prompt + respons tertangkap: 62 dan 1174 baris event; redaction rahasia aktif). Ini **bukan** bukti seluruh anggota lulus: tiap anggota wajib menjalankan smoke test pada instalasinya sendiri sebelum coding.
49: 
50: ## ADR-007 — Internals Decoder Block: pre-norm, FFN, aktivasi, dropout, epsilon
51: - Konteks: `TECH_SPEC.md` lama menunda keputusan pre-norm/post-norm; FFN, GELU, dropout, epsilon belum eksplisit; Issue #1 mencantumkannya sebagai kandidat.
52: - Keputusan: Pre-LayerNorm pada Decoder Block; `d_ff = 4 * d_model`; aktivasi GELU; dropout `0.1` (pada skor attention, output attention, dan FFN); LayerNorm epsilon `1e-5`.
53: - Alasan: Pre-norm lebih stabil untuk model kecil dan sejalan GPT-2 style; komponen lain mengikuti kandidat baseline Issue #1 yang telah disetujui.
54: - Trade-off: Pre-norm berbeda dari formulasi post-norm klasik dan menggeser beban ke residual; dropout mengurangi kapasitas model.
55: - Status: Accepted (Issue #1 Step 2).
56: 
57: ## ADR-008 — Tokenizer regex, lowercase, special tokens, dan padding
58: - Konteks: Tokenizer lama hanya menyebut "regex berbasis kata dan tanda baca"; aturan padding dan `<pad>` belum ada; Issue #1 menuntut aturan token khusus tidak ambigu.
59: - Keputusan: Regex `r"\w+|[^\w\s]"`; lowercase sebelum tokenisasi; vocab hanya dari train. Special tokens ber-ID tetap: `<pad>=0`, `<bos>=1`, `<eos>=2`, `<unk>=3`. `<bos>`/`<eos>` disisipkan sebagai token id setelah tokenisasi (bukan string literal ke regex). Padding dilakukan pada batching; loss memakai `ignore_index=pad_id`.
60: - Alasan: Lowercase mengecilkan vocab untuk model kecil; penambahan `<pad>` memungkinkan batch panjang seragam tanpa membuang dokumen pendek.
61: - Trade-off: Lowercase menghilangkan beda case proper noun; `decode` tidak menjamin roundtrip eksak.
62: - Status: Accepted (Issue #1 Step 2).
63: 
64: ## ADR-009 — Strategi generation greedy
65: - Konteks: Kontrak generation belum ada di dokumen lama; Issue #1 meminta perilaku generation eksplisit.
66: - Keputusan: Generation v1 greedy (argmax); berhenti pada `<eos>` atau `max_new_tokens`; konteks dibatasi `context_length` (window geser); `temperature` sampling opsional, tidak wajib pada implementasi pertama.
67: - Alasan: Sederhana, deterministik, cukup untuk demonstrasi dan test; sampling bisa ditambahkan belakangan tanpa ubah arsitektur.
68: - Trade-off: Greedy cenderung repetitif dibanding sampling.
69: - Status: Accepted (Issue #1 Step 2).
70: 
71: ## ADR-010 — Strategi split dan pembuatan window
72: - Konteks: `TECH_SPEC.md` §5 dan `DATASET_CARD.md` menuntut split per dokumen dan cegah kebocoran; rasio dan seed belum ditetapkan.
73: - Keputusan: Urutan — deduplikasi, split per dokumen (80/10/10, seed 42) hanya sebagai fallback jika split bawaan tidak tersedia/tidak layak; split bawaan yang terverifikasi dipertahankan tanpa resplit. Setelah split: tokenisasi, sisipkan `bos_id`/`eos_id`, lalu window sliding panjang 65 stride 1; dokumen pendek dipakai sebagai pasangan pendek + pad saat batching; dilarang window lintas dokumen.
74: - Alasan: Split per dokumen mencegah kebocoran antarartikel; window stride 1 memaksimalkan data dari subset kecil.
75: - Trade-off: Stride 1 menambah jumlah training sample (redudansi antar window overlapping); seed tetap menjadikan hasil reproducible.
76: - Status: Accepted (Issue #1 Step 2).
77: 
78: ## ADR-011 — Format metrik output: JSONL
79: - Konteks: `TECH_SPEC.md` §6 membiarkan dua opsi format metrik ("CSV/JSONL"); Issue C butuh satu format pasti.
80: - Keputusan: Metrik training per-epoch ditulis sebagai JSONL ke `outputs/metrics/` (satu objek JSON per baris).
81: - Alasan: JSONL append-friendly untuk logging per-epoch, mudah dibaca ulang dengan `pandas`/`json`; konsisten dengan raw AI log yang sudah JSONL.
82: - Trade-off: Kurang tabular dibanding CSV untuk spreadsheet langsung.
83: - Status: Accepted (disetujui koordinator 2026-10-19; verifikasi implementasi dicatat di Issue C).
84: 
85: ## ADR-012 — Jumlah subset dataset dan strategi validation split
86: - Konteks: `TECH_SPEC.md` §1 dan `DATASET_CARD.md` membiarkan range subset 500–2.000 artikel dan hanya menyebut fallback split 80/10/10; dataset bawaan menyediakan split train (25.8k) dan test (6.46k) tetapi tidak ada split validation.
87: - Keputusan: Subset = 1.000 artikel. Pertahankan split bawaan train/test tanpa resplit (ADR-010). Validation diambil 10% dari split train (seed 42). Fallback 80/10/10 tidak dipakai.
88: - Alasan: Data HF diverifikasi punya split bawaan; test bawaan tidak boleh diresplit; validation tetap dibutuhkan untuk memantau loss per-epoch (Issue C) sehingga disisihkan dari train secara deterministik. 1.000 artikel cukup untuk model kecil d64 di CPU dengan waktu training realistis.
89: - Trade-off: Rasio akhir bukan 80/10/10 murni (~72/8/20 terhadap total dataset); subset kecil membatasi kualitas generasi.
90: - Status: Accepted (disetujui koordinator 2026-10-19; angka aktual diverifikasi pada Issue A dan dicatat di DATASET_CARD).

1: # AI Rules & Vibe Engineering Standard
2: 
3: ## 1. Sumber instruksi
4: Semua AI coding agent wajib membaca `AGENTS.md` serta enam dokumen inti dalam `docs/`. Jika instruksi bertentangan, hentikan perubahan dan laporkan konfliknya. Issue kerja tersedia lokal di folder `issues/`; AI agent tidak perlu akses GitHub.
5: 
6: ## 2. Format prompt wajib
7: Setiap prompt coding harus memuat:
8: 1. Context proyek dan Issue.
9: 2. Task spesifik.
10: 3. Specification/interface dan tensor shapes.
11: 4. Constraints, file yang boleh diubah, dependensi yang diizinkan.
12: 5. Expected output.
13: 6. Acceptance criteria dan test yang diperlukan.
14: 7. Penjelasan algoritma, kompleksitas, asumsi, edge cases, dan keterbatasan.
15: 
16: ## 3. Template prompt
17: 
18: > Anda bekerja pada proyek Mini-GPT berbahasa Indonesia. Ikuti `AGENTS.md`, `docs/TECH_SPEC.md`, dan `docs/AI_RULES.md`. Kerjakan hanya modul [NAMA MODUL] pada Issue [NOMOR]. Sebelum menulis kode, jelaskan rencana implementasi, tensor shapes, dependensi, kompleksitas, dan edge cases. Setelah itu, hasilkan perubahan minimal pada file yang ditugaskan, sertakan unit test dan instruksi menjalankannya. Jangan mengubah interface modul lain atau menambah dependensi tanpa persetujuan. Jangan menyatakan tes berhasil jika belum dijalankan.
19: 
20: ## 4. Batas perubahan
21: - Satu Issue per unit kerja.
22: - Jangan mengubah kontrak publik atau file di luar scope tanpa persetujuan.
23: - Jangan menambah dependency tanpa alasan dan persetujuan.
24: - Jangan menggunakan API/model pretrained sebagai model utama.
25: - Jangan menggunakan modul Transformer lengkap untuk menggantikan attention/decoder manual.
26: - Kode baru harus dilengkapi test atau alasan teknis yang jelas jika test belum layak dibuat.
27: 
28: ## 5. Aturan output AI
29: - Nyatakan file yang akan diubah sebelum implementasi.
30: - Jelaskan keputusan teknis secara singkat.
31: - Tampilkan perintah pengujian dan hasil aktual.
32: - Pisahkan fakta yang diketahui dari asumsi.
33: - Jangan mengarang error, hasil test, metadata model, atau bukti dataset.
34: 
35: ## 6. Logging
36: - Prompt, respons yang terlihat, event tool, dan error harus direkam oleh mekanisme logging yang telah diuji.
37: - Jangan menulis API key, token, password, atau data sensitif ke log.
38: - Jika logger gagal, jangan melanjutkan coding proyek tanpa memberitahu anggota tim dan memperbaiki logger.
39: - Raw log adalah bukti; ringkasan AI bukan pengganti raw log.
40: ## 7. Review dan push (master-only)
41: 
42: - Gunakan satu branch utama `master`. Dilarang membuat branch baru, pull request, atau merge.
43: - Seluruh operasi Git (commit, push, pull, branch, merge, staging) dilakukan oleh anggota, bukan AI agent.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn


class SinCosPositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    """Sinusoidal positional encoding per TECH_SPEC 6.

    - Kontrak:
    - buffer `pe: [max_len, d_model]` non-trainable;
    - `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]`, menambahkan `pe[:T]`;
    - `T > max_len` -> `ValueError`.
    """

    def __init__(self, d_model: int, max_len: int) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.d_model = d_model
        self.max_len = max_len

        positions = torch.arange(max_len, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(1)
        div_term = 10000.0 ** (torch.arange(d_model, dtype=torch.float32) / d_model)
        angles = positions / div_term
        pe = torch.empty(max_len, d_model, dtype=torch.float32)
        pe[:, 0::2] = torch.sin(angles[:, 0::2])
        pe[:, 1::2] = torch.cos(angles[:, 1::2])
        self.register_buffer("pe", pe)

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        if x.dim() != 3:
            raise ValueError(f"expected 3D input [B, T, d_model], got {x.dim()}D")
        if x.size(-1) != self.d_model:
            raise ValueError(f"expected last dim {self.d_model}, got {x.size(-1)}")
        t = x.size(1)
        if t > self.max_len:
            raise ValueError(f"sequence length {t} > max_len {self.max_len}")
        return x + self.pe[:t]

Implementation:
```python
class FeedForward(nn.Module):
    """Position-wise FFN: Linear(d_model, d_ff) -> GELU -> Linear(d_ff, d_model) -> dropout."""

    def __init__(self, d_model: int, d_ff: int, dropout: float = 0.1) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.d_model = d_model
        self.d_ff = d_ff
        self.dropout = dropout
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(d_model, d_ff)
        self.activation = nn.GELU()
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(d_ff, d_model)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        if x.dim() != 3:
            raise ValueError(f"expected 3D input [B, T, d_model], got {x.dim()}D")
        if x.size(-1) != self.d_model:
            raise ValueError(f"expected last dim {self.d_model}, got {x.size(-1)}")
        return self.drop(self.fc2(self.activation(self.fc1(x))))
```

66: 2. Minta AI menjelaskan tujuan subtask, rumus/enterpretasi tensor shapes `[B, T, d]`, kompleksitas `O(B·T²·d)` / `O(B·H·T²)`, dan edge cases SEBELUM menulis kode.
67: 3. Implementasikan satu subtask saja (perubahan minimal, manual tanpa `nn.MultiheadAttention`/`nn.Transformer*`).
68: 4. Jalankan test subtask itu dan amati output aktual.
69: 5. Jika error, pahami dan perbaiki; catat bukti reproduksi error.
70: 6. Simpan log AI (raw JSONL + laporan Markdown) sesuai ADR-006.

72: 8. Centang checkbox subtask hanya setelah hasil dan test benar-benar terverifikasi.

75: 
76: - Setelah satu subtask selesai dan diverifikasi, **berhenti**. Jangan mengerjakan subtask berikutnya tanpa instruksi eksplisit.
77: - Jangan membangun komponen selanjutnya sebelum komponen yang menjadi prasyaratnya lulus test.
78: - Jika hasil test gagal atau log AI belum tersimpan, **jangan lanjut**; perbaiki dulu.
79: - Jangan mengklaim test lulus jika belum dijalankan; jangan mengarang shape, gradien, atau hasil tes.
80: 
81: ## 10. Acceptance criteria (wajib benar-benar diuji)
82: 
83: - [ ] Tidak ada `nn.Transformer`, `nn.TransformerDecoder`, atau `nn.MultiheadAttention` pada jalur inti.
84: - [ ] Tensor shapes output sesuai §6 untuk input acak (test shape dijalankan dan diamati).

Docstring:
```python
class FeedForward(nn.Module):
    """Position-wise Feed-Forward Network dengan GELU per TECH_SPEC 6 / ADR-007.

    - Kontrak:
    - `Linear(d_model, d_ff)` -> GELU -> `Linear(d_ff, d_model)` -> dropout;
    - baseline `d_ff = 4 * d_model = 256`, dropout `0.1`;
    - `forward(x: [B, T, d_model]) -> [B, T, d_model]`, identik per posisi;
    - `d_model <= 0` atau `d_ff <= 0` -> `ValueError` saat inisialisasi.
    """
```

Init:
```python
def __init__(self, d_model: int, d_ff: int, dropout: float = 0.1) -> None:
    super().__init__()
    if d_model <= 0 or d_ff <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"d_model ({d_model}) and d_ff ({d_ff}) must be > 0")
    self.d_model = d_model
    self.d_ff = d_ff
    self.dropout = dropout
    self.fc1 = nn.Linear(d_model, d_ff)
    self.activation = nn.GELU()
    self.fc2 = nn.Linear(d_ff, d_model)
    self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
```

Forward:
```python
def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """x: [B, T, d_model] -> [B, T, d_model]."""
    if x.dim() != 3:
        raise ValueError(f"expected 3D input [B, T, d_model], got {x.dim()}D")
    if x.size(-1) != self.d_model:
        raise ValueError(f"expected last dim {self.d_model}, got {x.size(-1)}")
    return self.drop(self.fc2(self.activation(self.fc1(x))))
```

New tests in test_decoder_block.py:

```python
class TestFeedForward(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_output_shape(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        _assert_shape(ffn(torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)), (B, T, D_MODEL))

    def test_linear_layer_shapes(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc1.weight.shape, (D_FF, D_MODEL))
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc1.bias.shape, (D_FF,))
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc2.weight.shape, (D_MODEL, D_FF))
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc2.bias.shape, (D_MODEL,))

    def test_matches_manual_gelu_computation(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF, dropout=0.0)
        ffn.eval()
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        expected = ffn.fc2(F.gelu(ffn.fc1(x)))
        torch.testing.assert_close(ffn(x), expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

    def test_dropout_train_differs_from_eval(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF, dropout=DROPOUT)
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        ffn.train()
        out_train_a = ffn(x)
        out_train_b = ffn(x)
        ffn.eval()
        out_eval_a = ffn(x)
        out_eval_b = ffn(x)
        self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(out_train_a, out_train_b))
        torch.testing.assert_close(out_eval_a, out_eval_b, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

    def test_gradient_flows_to_all_parameters(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        ffn(x).sum().backward()
        for name, param in ffn.named_parameters():
            self.assertIsNotNone(param.grad, f"param {name} has None gradient")
            self.assertTrue(torch.count_nonzero(param.grad) > 0, f"param {name} grad zero")

    def test_value_error_on_nonpositive_dims(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            FeedForward(0, D_FF)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            FeedForward(D_MODEL, 0)

    def test_value_error_on_wrong_input(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ffn(torch.randn(B, D_MODEL))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ffn(torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL - 1))
```

class TestFeedForward(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_output_shape(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        _assert_shape(ffn(torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)), (B, T, D_MODEL))

    def test_linear_layer_shapes(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc1.weight.shape, (D_FF, D_MODEL))
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc1.bias.shape, (D_FF,))
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc2.weight.shape, (D_MODEL, D_FF))
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc2.bias.shape, (D_MODEL,))

    def test_matches_manual_gelu_computation(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF, dropout=0.0)
        ffn.eval()
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        expected = ffn.fc2(F.gelu(ffn.fc1(x)))
        torch.testing.assert_close(ffn(x), expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

    def test_dropout_train_differs_from_eval(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF, dropout=DROPOUT)
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        ffn.train()
        out_train_a = ffn(x)
        out_train_b = ffn(x)
        ffn.eval()
        out_eval_a = ffn(x)
        out_eval_b = ffn(x)
        self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(out_train_a, out_train_b))
        torch.testing.assert_close(out_eval_a, out_eval_b, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

    def test_gradient_flows_to_all_parameters(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        ffn(x).sum().backward()
        for name, param in ffn.named_parameters():
            self.assertIsNotNone(param.grad, f"param {name} has None gradient")
            self.assertTrue(
                torch.count_nonzero(param.grad) > 0, f"param {name} grad zero"
            )

    def test_value_error_on_nonpositive_dims(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            FeedForward(0, D_FF)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            FeedForward(D_MODEL, 0)

    def test_value_error_on_wrong_input(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ffn(torch.randn(B, D_MODEL))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ffn(torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL - 1))

class TestFeedForward(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_output_shape(self):

        _assert_shape(ffn(torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)), (B, T, D_MODEL))

        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc2.weight.shape, (D_MODEL, D_FF))
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc2.bias.shape, (D_MODEL,))

        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF, dropout=0.0)
        ffn.eval()

        expected = ffn.fc2(F.gelu(ffn.fc1(x)))
        torch.testing.assert_close(ffn(x), expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF, dropout=DROPOUT)

        out_train_a = ffn(x)
        out_train_b = ffn(x)
        ffn.eval()
        out_eval_a = ffn(x)
        out_eval_b = ffn(x)
        self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(out_train_a, out_train_b))
        torch.testing.assert_close(out_eval_a, out_eval_b, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)

        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ffn(torch.randn(B, D_MODEL))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ffn(torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL - 1))

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

from src.model.decoder_block import DecoderBlock, FeedForward

B, T, D_MODEL = 2, 8, 64
N_HEADS = 4
D_FF = 4 * D_MODEL
DROPOUT = 0.1
LAYER_NORM_EPS = 1e-5


def _assert_shape(tensor: torch.Tensor, expected: tuple) -> None:
    assert tuple(tensor.shape) == expected, (
        f"shape {tuple(tensor.shape)} != expected {expected}"
    )


class TestFeedForward(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_output_shape(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        _assert_shape(ffn(torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)), (B, T, D_MODEL))

    def test_linear_layer_shapes(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc1.weight.shape, (D_FF, D_MODEL))
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc1.bias.shape, (D_FF,))
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc2.weight.shape, (D_MODEL, D_FF))
        self.assertEqual(ffn.fc2.bias.shape, (D_MODEL,))

    def test_matches_manual_gelu_computation(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF, dropout=0.0)
        ffn.eval()
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        expected = ffn.fc2(F.gelu(ffn.fc1(x)))
        torch.testing.assert_close(ffn(x), expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

    def test_dropout_train_differs_from_eval(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF, dropout=DROPOUT)
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        ffn.train()
        out_train_a = ffn(x)
        out_train_b = ffn(x)
        ffn.eval()
        out_eval_a = ffn(x)
        out_eval_b = ffn(x)
        self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(out_train_a, out_train_b))
        torch.testing.assert_close(out_eval_a, out_eval_b, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)

    def test_gradient_flows_to_all_parameters(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        ffn(x).sum().backward()
        for name, param in ffn.named_parameters():
            self.assertIsNotNone(param.grad, f"param {name} has None gradient")
            self.assertTrue(
                torch.count_nonzero(param.grad) > 0, f"param {name} grad zero"
            )

    def test_value_error_on_nonpositive_dims(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            FeedForward(0, D_FF)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            FeedForward(D_MODEL, 0)

    def test_value_error_on_wrong_input(self):
        ffn = FeedForward(D_MODEL, D_FF)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ffn(torch.randn(B, D_MODEL))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ffn(torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL - 1))


@unittest.skip("skeleton B2; prediction dijalankan di B12")
class TestDecoderBlockShape(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_output_shape(self):
        block = DecoderBlock(D_MODEL, N_HEADS, D_FF)
        _assert_shape(block(torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)), (B, T, D_MODEL))


@unittest.skip("skeleton B2; prediction dijalankan di B12")
class TestResidualConnection(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_output_differs_from_input(self):
        block = DecoderBlock(D_MODEL, N_HEADS, D_FF, dropout=DROPOUT)
        block.eval()
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        out = block(x)
        self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(out, x, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6))


@unittest.skip("skeleton B2; prediction dijalankan di B12")
class TestDropoutBehavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_train_differs_from_eval(self):
        block = DecoderBlock(D_MODEL, N_HEADS, D_FF, dropout=DROPOUT)
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        block.train()
        out_train_a = block(x)
        out_train_b = block(x)
        block.eval()
        out_eval_a = block(x)
        out_eval_b = block(x)
        self.assertFalse(torch.allclose(out_train_a, out_train_b))
        torch.testing.assert_close(out_eval_a, out_eval_b, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6)


@unittest.skip("skeleton B2; prediction dijalankan di B12")
class TestGradients(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gradients_flow_to_all_parameters(self):
        block = DecoderBlock(D_MODEL, N_HEADS, D_FF)
        x = torch.randn(B, T, D_MODEL)
        loss = block(x).sum()
        loss.backward()
        for name, param in block.named_parameters():
            self.assertIsNotNone(param.grad, f"param {name} has None gradient")
            self.assertTrue(torch.count_nonzero(param.grad) > 0, f"param {name} grad zero")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

part.text:
7 passed, 4 skipped (B12 skeleton). Now verify acceptance criteria:
- No nn.Transformer/nn.MultiheadAttention on FFN path: only nn.Linear, nn.GELU, nn.Dropout. ✓
- Shapes ✓
- Gradient non-None ✓ (tested)
- ValueError edge cases ✓
- Complexity documented already in TECH_SPEC §7, will be in report.

Also quick sanity: run full suite? Unrelated tests may need dataset/HF network. Skip — subtask scope only decoder_block tests. Also confirm no imports of forbidden modules — the class uses only nn.Linear/GELU/Dropout.

Checkpoint: report per instructions. No git ops. Logging: plugin (ADR-006) records session automatically; report Markdown member fills later from raw JSONL — I note this.

Show changed files (full content shown via tool earlier; reference them). Report criteria met/failures/limitation.

B10 selesai. Test lulus.

## Yang berubah
- `src/model/decoder_block.py` — kelas `FeedForward(d_model, d_ff, dropout=0.1)` ditambah di atas `DecoderBlock` (stub B11 tidak disentuh).
- `tests/test_decoder_block.py` — `TestFeedForward` 7 test ditambah; import `FeedForward` + `torch.nn.functional as F`.

## Implementasi FFN
```
fc1: Linear(d_model, d_ff)   # [B, T, d_model] -> [B, T, d_ff = 256]
activation: nn.GELU()        # erf, position-wise per token
fc2: Linear(d_ff, d_model)   # [B, T, d_ff] -> [B, T, 64]
drop: nn.Dropout(0.1)
```
- Alasan milih `nn.GELU()`: diizinkan batas library (§2 — bukan pengganti inti manual), GELU erf default konsisten dengan `F.gelu` test.
- Validasi edge case: `d_model ≤ 0`/`d_ff ≤ 0` → `ValueError` di init (cegah Linear degenerat); input rank ≠ 3 atau last dim ≠ d_model → `ValueError` di `forward` (pola sama PE/MHA).
- Kompleksitas waktu `O(B·T·d_ff·d) = O(B·T·d²)`, aktivasi memori `O(B·T·d_ff)` per TECH_SPEC §7.

## Output test aktual
```

tests/test_decoder_block.py::TestFeedForward::test_gradient_flows_to_all_parameters PASSED

(TestDecoderBlockShape/Residual/Dropout/Gradients: SKIPPED — skeleton B11-B12, di luar scope B10)
=================== 7 passed, 4 skipped in 5.14s ====================
```

## Acceptance criteria B10
- [x] Bedah: shape output `(B, T, 64)` lulus; gradien `fc1`/`fc2` non-None + nonzero setelah `loss.backward()` lulus; dropout train ≠ eval lulus; GELU sesuai `F.gelu` manual lulus; `ValueError` non-positif + input salah lulus.
- [x] Tanpa `nn.Transformer*`/`nn.MultiheadAttention` di jalur FFN — hanya `nn.Linear`, `nn.GELU`, `nn.Dropout`.
- [x] Kompleksitas §7 terdokumentasi di TECH_SPEC; laporan eksperimen menyusul di B14.

## Limitasi / catatan
- FFN standalone sengaja publik (`FeedForward`) agar bisa diuji B10; pemakaiannya di `DecoderBlock` = B11, belum dikerjakan.
- Logging: plugin ADR-006 merekam sesi otomatis (raw JSONL). Laporan Markdown `docs/ai-logs/reports/AI-LOG-…` sesuai template + review anggota lain menyusul — belum dibuat, mencegah nomor sesi dikarang.
- Tanpa operasi Git.

Stop di sini. Tunggu review sebelum lanjut B11.
